envelope.description: Expose read-only progress and deterministic user updates

body.title: Expose read-only progress and deterministic user updates
body.summary: Add validated codeReview.task.progress delegation and deterministic formatter/poll guidance:5sec reads, immediate changes/terminal errors and45sec ongoing updates. No execution restart, provider calls or normal MCP migration. Include a cancellable explicit task-review polling helper using existing IPC client, injectable clock and update callback; controller can use this without retired endpoints.
acceptanceChecks: Read validates project/review/attempt and does not invoke provider/resume
User sees immediate changes and45sec updates; stale/unknown explicit; no percentage estimates
Concrete helper emits updates via callback, cancels cleanly and never retriggers review

tests.name: Read-only progress IPC validates scope and never invokes providers
Polling helper emits immediate transitions and45sec updates and cancels cleanly
